title: How to be a Psychologist when you're not in the mood!

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，要是你们能超越出卖时间换取金钱的模式来赚钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己是在2022年完成这个项目的，从那以后，我也一直在协助两届心理学家走过他们的成长之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，不收取任何额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括为期六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场大师班指导群、大师课、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 欢迎通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, your guide, decide to be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trey.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，你的向导，决定踏上“有志心理学家”播客之旅，我是玛丽安·特雷博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有志心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: If you are listening on the day that this is released, it will be Monday the 9th of May, then you're in luck.
sentences.zh: 如果你在节目发布的当天——也就是5月9日星期一收听，那么你真走运。

sentences.en: You can listen, come along live to the final planned compassionate Q&A, which you can grab via all of my socials, all of them.
sentences.zh: 你可以收听并来到现场参加最后一次计划中的有同理心的问答环节，你可以通过我的所有社交平台获取，所有的平台哦。

sentences.en: I'm on LinkedIn, which is Dr. Marianne Trent, and the same for Instagram, the same for Twitter,
sentences.zh: 我在领英上的名字是Dr. Marianne Trent，Instagram和推特也是这个名字，

sentences.en: and then I am Good Thinking Psychological Services for both YouTube and for Facebook.
sentences.zh: 然后在YouTube和Facebook上，我的名字是Good Thinking Psychological Services。

sentences.en: If you're on YouTube, it's only fair to come along and subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上，顺便来点个关注也是合情合理的。

sentences.en: And whilst you're there, just like a bit of the content and fling in a few little nice comments.
sentences.zh: 当你在那儿的时候，顺便点个赞，再留下几条暖心的评论。

sentences.en: You know, you know, you know, it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你知道的，你知道的，这很有意义。

sentences.en: And I don't often remind you of this, but all of the podcast episodes are available to watch on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我不常提醒你们这一点，但所有的播客单集都可以在YouTube上观看。

sentences.en: If it's just me chatting, because frankly, I don't always want to put my makeup on.
sentences.zh: 如果只是我自己在聊天的话，因为坦白说，我并不总是想化妆。

sentences.en: And yeah, so if it's an interview, it is usually stuff that you can watch me and the interview gueSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果是访谈节目，通常你都可以看到我和访谈嘉宾的画面。

sentences.en: But it's been a while since it's just been me.
sentences.zh: 但已经很久只有我一个人了。

sentences.en: So I thought I'd check in with you, see how you're finding the guest interviews.
sentences.zh: 所以我盘算着来跟你们唠唠，看看你们觉得嘉宾访谈怎么样。

sentences.en: How are you finding the podcast more generally as well?
sentences.zh: 你们觉得这个播客整体怎么样？

sentences.en: I would love any feedback that you've got.
sentences.zh: 我很欢迎你们提出任何反馈。

sentences.en: And if you really feel so inclined, if you've got like a spare couple of moments, if you go along to the Apple podcast app, find my podcast, the Aspiring Psychologist podcast,
sentences.zh: 如果你真的很有兴致，如果你刚好有几分钟空闲，你可以打开苹果播客应用，找到我的播客——“有志心理学家”播客，

sentences.en: and then scroll down right to the bottom, right below the trailer.
sentences.zh: 然后一直滚动到最底部，就在预告片下方。

sentences.en: And then you can rate.
sentences.zh: 接着你就可以打分了。

sentences.en: And if you've got a few more moments, you can leave me a little review.
sentences.zh: 如果你还有多余的时间，还可以给我留个简短的评论。

sentences.en: It would be so gratefully received.
sentences.zh: 我会对你们的反馈充满感激。

sentences.en: And if you really love the podcast,
sentences.zh: 如果你真的很喜欢这个播客，

sentences.en: you could consider making a small donation to help cover the costs of making it and producing it and hosting it and transcribing it and all of that good stuff.
sentences.zh: 你可以考虑进行一小笔捐赠，用来支付制作、出品、托管、文字转录以及所有这些好东西的费用。

sentences.en: If you would like to do that, you can head to my Linktree account, which you can find on all of my socials.
sentences.zh: 如果你想这么做，你可以访问我的Linktree账号，它可以在我的所有社交平台上找到。

sentences.en: The details for the Linktree account are also in the show notes for this episode.
sentences.zh: Linktree账号的详细信息也在这期节目的shownotes（节目笔记）中。

sentences.en: So today's episode is all about being, you know, there as a source of support for people, as we do when we're working in psychology, whatever branch of psychology you are in.
sentences.zh: 所以今天的节目主要讲的是，你知道的，作为一个能够为他人提供支持的人，正如我们在心理学领域工作时所做的那样，无论你从事心理学的哪个分支。

sentences.en: And maybe you don't even work in psychology currently, or maybe you never are going to because I know some people contact me and they're like,
sentences.zh: 也许你目前甚至没有从事心理学工作，或者你永远都不会从事，因为我知道有些人联系我说：

sentences.en: I'm not ever going to be a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: “我永远也不会成为一名心理学家。”

sentences.en: But I do really enjoy listening to your stuff.
sentences.zh: “但我真的很喜欢听你的节目。”

sentences.en: So whoever you are, whatever you do, thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你是谁，无论你做什么，谢谢你收听。

sentences.en: I should just say, if the audio quality of this is not quite as good as usual, it's because, well, it's in keeping with the theme of today.
sentences.zh: 我得说一下，如果这段音频的音质没有平时那么好，那是因为，嗯，这很符合今天的主题。

sentences.en: So I haven't got my professional mic and things out.
sentences.zh: 所以我没有把专业的麦克风那些东西拿出来。

sentences.en: I'm just going rogue with the AirPods, but it's on brand.
sentences.zh: 我就直接用AirPods野路子搞定，但这也符合我的一贯风格。

sentences.en: It's on brand.
sentences.zh: 符合我的一贯风格。

sentences.en: And my lovely friend, Michaela, who specializes in perfectionism and letting it go, I hope that she will absolutely salute this episode,
sentences.zh: 我可爱的朋友米凯拉，她专攻完美主义以及如何放下完美主义，我希望她绝对会为这期节目点赞，

sentences.en: even if the audio is not quite as good as it is when it's usually my solo endeavors.
sentences.zh: 即使音频质量不如平时我独自录制时那么好。

sentences.en: You may have noticed at the beginning, the audio was a little bit dodgier.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经注意到，刚开始的时候音频稍微差了一点。

sentences.en: And then I invested in an expensive mic, which didn't work very well.
sentences.zh: 然后我投资买了一个昂贵的麦克风，结果不太好用。

sentences.en: I'd like to re-record.
sentences.zh: 我想重新录制。

sentences.en: And then we stumbled across a mic which worked really well.
sentences.zh: 接着我们偶然发现了一个非常好用的麦克风。

sentences.en: But it is quite an involved process.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个相当繁琐的过程。

sentences.en: And today I just thought, oh, I don't want to, I don't want to get all the mic out.
sentences.zh: 今天我只是觉得，哦，我不想，我不想把所有麦克风都拿出来。

sentences.en: I'm just going to, I'm just going to go rogue with my, with my AirPods and my Zoom account.
sentences.zh: 我打算，我打算直接用我的AirPods和Zoom账号随性发挥了。

sentences.en: So please forgive me.
sentences.zh: 所以请大家原谅我。

sentences.en: But yeah, I digress.
sentences.zh: 不过话说回来，我扯远了。

sentences.en: So when we're working with clients in whatever capacity you're working with them, you are always a human.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们以任何身份与客户工作时，你始终是一个人。

sentences.en: And as humans, we don't always want to do our job.
sentences.zh: 作为人类，我们并不总是想去工作。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: And that is what today is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的主题。

sentences.en: You know, so this was inspired by me having a bit of a sad moment.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这源于我当时有点伤感的时刻。

sentences.en: I don't know if you guys have ever watched the most wonderful show.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们有没有看过一部最棒的剧。

sentences.en: It's called This Is Us.
sentences.zh: 它叫《我们这一天》。

sentences.en: And it's on Amazon.
sentences.zh: 在亚马逊上可以看。

sentences.en: And I first discovered it when I was 36.
sentences.zh: 我36岁时第一次发现这部剧。

sentences.en: And I was on sick leave from my job because my dad had just died.
sentences.zh: 当时我正因为父亲刚去世而在请病假。

sentences.en: And I won't be spoiling anything if you haven't already watched it.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没看过，我这么说绝不会剧透。

sentences.en: When I tell you that it's all about siblings who turn 36 in the first episode.
sentences.zh: 那就是它讲述的是在第一集里迎来36岁生日的一群兄弟姐妹的故事。

sentences.en: And it felt so very appropriate and relevant to my life.
sentences.zh: 这让我觉得与我的生活非常契合、息息相关。

sentences.en: And so it's felt like a really personal show for me.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说是一部非常私人、很有意义的剧。

sentences.en: And then on Friday, I found out that this is going to be the last series of This Is Us.
sentences.zh: 然后上周五，我得知这将是《我们这一天》的最后一季。

sentences.en: And I just wasn't ready for that because I'm sure originally they said there was going to be like 10 series.
sentences.zh: 我还没做好心理准备，因为我确信他们最初说会有大约10季的。

sentences.en: And this is only series six.
sentences.zh: 而这居然只是第六季。

sentences.en: And so I wasn't ready.
sentences.zh: 所以我还没有准备好。

sentences.en: And so as I'm watching the episodes, I'm feeling myself wanting to cry all the way through them.
sentences.zh: 所以在看这些剧集时，我发现自己一整集都想哭。

sentences.en: Because I'm just not ready to say goodbye to these characters.
sentences.zh: 因为我还没准备好跟这些角色说再见。

sentences.en: Because it feels so personal to me and my life.
sentences.zh: 因为这对我以及我的生活来说太具有个人意义了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, this is kind of, I guess, relevant to psychology as well, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，这其实也跟心理学息息相关，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because sometimes, you know, we will have deep connections with our clients and the people we're working with and staff teams that we're working with.
sentences.zh: 因为有时候，你知道的，我们与客户、与我们共事的人以及我们共事的员工团队之间会建立起深厚的联系。

sentences.en: And we won't feel ready to say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 而我们不会觉得准备好说再见了。

sentences.en: And sometimes our clients won't feel ready to say goodbye either.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们的客户也不会觉得准备好说再见了。

sentences.en: And due to service pressures or due to service limits or due to, you know, you moving on or them moving on or, you know,
sentences.zh: 由于服务压力、服务限制，或者由于你离职或他们离职，或者是，你知道的，

sentences.en: them no longer meeting the criteria for service if they're getting better, you may need to say goodbye to each other before you're ready to.
sentences.zh: 如果他们情况好转，不再符合服务的标准，你们可能不得不在彼此准备好之前就道别。

sentences.en: But this is a whole separate issue that I might well come back to at the end of this podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 但这其实是一个完全独立的话题，我很有可能会在这个播客节目的最后再回过头来谈谈。

sentences.en: But today's topic is how do we do this psychology or work malarkey when you're not feeling it, you know, because sometimes we want to lay on our sofa and, you know,
sentences.zh: 但今天的主题是，当你感觉不对劲时，我们该如何应付这份心理学或工作上的破事呢？因为有时候我们只想躺在沙发上，你知道的，

sentences.en: watch this is us.
sentences.zh: 看《我们这一天》。

sentences.en: That's what we want to do.
sentences.zh: 这才是我们想做的事。

sentences.en: Sometimes we don't want to be, you know, getting all up in someone else's business and trying to sort out tricky things.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们才不想，你知道的，去掺和别人的烂摊子，还努力去解决棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And I guess the important thing to work out here is if it is, you know, just an ebb and a flow issue, sometimes we will feel further apart from, you know, wanting to be at work.
sentences.zh: 我想这里需要弄清楚的重要一点是，这是否只是一种情绪的起伏，有时候我们会觉得离“想要上班”这种状态更远一些。

sentences.en: And sometimes we will feel very unwell.
sentences.zh: 而有时候我们会感觉非常不舒服。

sentences.en: And that's the difference, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是区别所在，你知道的。

sentences.en: So if you feel like you might be burned out, if you feel like you can't, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你觉得自己可能精疲力竭了，如果你觉得你无法，你知道的，

sentences.en: put your own things to one side for long enough to do therapy or intervention or assessment with a client,
sentences.zh: 把自己的事情放在一边足够长的时间，来对客户进行治疗、干预或评估，

sentences.en: then that is maybe a sign that you ought not to be at work at the moment and whether you could discuss that with your supervisor,
sentences.zh: 那么这可能是一个信号，表明你目前不应该去上班，你可以和你的主管讨论这个问题，

sentences.en: whether you could discuss that with your GP even about whether a period of time off work might be might be the best thing for you at this present moment.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以和你的全科医生讨论，看看休假一段时间是否是你目前最好的选择。

sentences.en: However, what I'm talking about is the general malaise of day to day life and on the whole, even on days that I think, oh, I'd rather stay in bed today.
sentences.zh: 然而，我所说的是日常生活中的普遍倦怠，总的来说，甚至在我认为“天哪，我今天宁愿赖在床上”的日子里也是如此。

sentences.en: And you might be like, I can't believe this qualified clinical psychologist is saying that because I know when I, before I became a qualified psychologist,
sentences.zh: 你可能会想：“真不敢相信这位合格的临床心理学家会这么说”，因为我知道自我成为合格心理学家之前，

sentences.en: before I became a trainee, I kind of was thinking, you know, this is the Holy Grail when I'm a trainee, when I'm qualified, you know, life will be amazing.
sentences.zh: 在我成为实习生之前，我有点觉得，你知道的，这就是圣杯，当我成为实习生时，当我合格时，你知道的，生活将会无比美好。

sentences.en: And I will have a spring in my step every day and, you know, and all of the traffic lights will be on green when I come to them and I'll be so happy.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会步履轻盈，你知道的，而且我遇到的所有红绿灯都会变成绿灯，我会超级开心。

sentences.en: I will just want to skip everywhere, you know, like my five-year-old does, which is adorable.
sentences.zh: 我只想走到哪儿都一蹦一跳的，你知道的，就像我五岁的小孩那样，太可爱了。

sentences.en: But yeah, I am not quite so perky as my five-year-old quite a lot of the time.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，很多时候我可不像我五岁的小孩那么有活力。

sentences.en: Life will get its dents in you, whether you are doing the job you want to do or not.
sentences.zh: 生活会在你身上留下痕迹，无论你做的是不是你想做的工作。

sentences.en: And so how do we go about doing everything we do if you're not really feeling it on any given day?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果在某一天你真的没什么感觉，我们又该如何完成我们所做的一切呢？

sentences.en: And I will share my little hints and tips with you after this short break.
sentences.zh: 在这段短暂的休息之后，我将与大家分享我的小提示和建议。

sentences.en: So have a little listen and I will see you on the other side of this.
sentences.zh: 所以请稍微听一下，我们休息后见。

sentences.en: My name is Diakalola Amujam.
sentences.zh: 我叫迪亚卡洛拉·阿穆贾姆。

sentences.en: I am a recent psychology graduate from Ireland.
sentences.zh: 我是来自爱尔兰的应届心理学专业毕业生。

sentences.en: I am also an aspiring clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我同时也是一名有志成为临床心理学家的人。

sentences.en: Dr. Marion's book, The Clinical Psychologist Collective, has been so helpful to me on this journey to becoming a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 玛丽安博士的书《临床心理学家合集》在我成为临床心理学家的路上给予了极大的帮助。

sentences.en: As I plan to continue postgraduate studies in the UK, I found it extremely useful that this book provided in-depth information on the UK de-ClinSci application process.
sentences.zh: 由于我计划在英国继续攻读研究生，我发现这本书提供了关于英国临床心理学博士（ClinSci）申请流程的深入信息，这极其有用。

sentences.en: I enjoyed reading about the experiences of both qualified and training clinical psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢阅读合格的临床心理学家和实习临床心理学家的经验分享。

sentences.en: The various narratives were my favourite part of the book, as everyone's story was different and it provided amazing insights into the clinical psychology journey.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的故事是我最喜欢的部分，因为每个人的故事都不同，它为临床心理学之旅提供了令人惊叹的深刻见解。

sentences.en: I would definitely recommend this book to anyone interested in psychology and aspires to become a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会把这本书推荐给任何对心理学感兴趣并立志成为临床心理学家的人。

sentences.en: Okay, so when I am well enough to be at work, I do honestly find that once I start a session with a client, that any feeling of rather being on the sofa dies away.
sentences.zh: 好了，所以当我身体状况允许去上班时，我真的发现，一旦我开始与客户进行咨询，任何想躺在沙发上的感觉都会烟消云散。

sentences.en: You know, it's not an issue anymore.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这不再是个问题了。

sentences.en: I genuinely enjoy my job.
sentences.zh: 我是真心喜欢我的工作。

sentences.en: I really enjoy creating content for you as well.
sentences.zh: 我也非常喜欢为你们创作内容。

sentences.en: So although I was feeling like I'd rather watch This Is Us, once I get started, I really enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管我一开始觉得我宁愿去看《我们这一天》，但一旦开始做了，我真的很享受。

sentences.en: And I speak to you on a weekend and I do usually record these midweek, but you maybe have to hear in my voice that I haven't been fully well this week.
sentences.zh: 我是在周末跟你们说话的，我通常在周中录音，但你们或许能从我的声音里听出我这周身体没完全好透。

sentences.en: So I've kind of felt okay.
sentences.zh: 所以我感觉还行吧。

sentences.en: But as one of my clients said, it sounded like I'd been left in the rain outside because my voice wasn't very squeaky and had a bit of a cough and a bit of a sniffly nose.
sentences.zh: 但正如我的一个客户所说，听起来就像我被丢在外面淋雨了一样，因为我的声音不太清脆，而且有点咳嗽还带着点鼻音。

sentences.en: So I wasn't really podcast ready in the week.
sentences.zh: 所以我这周的状态实在不适合录播客。

sentences.en: So it's led to me just having a little bit more of a hustle to get this done.
sentences.zh: 这导致我不得不加把劲来完成它。

sentences.en: But I really am enjoying the consistency of this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很享受这个播客内容的连贯性。

sentences.en: So when I first launched it, I was creating, you know, I created the first eight and they were good to go.
sentences.zh: 所以当我刚推出它的时候，我在制作，你知道的，我制作了前八期，随时可以发布。

sentences.en: And, you know, I probably should have recorded more at that point.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我当时可能应该录制更多的。

sentences.en: I did did some along the way, but it's got to the stage now where, yeah, I'm running out of already created content.
sentences.zh: 我确实在过程中陆续录了一些，但现在已经到了这个阶段，是的，我之前制作好的内容快用完了。

sentences.en: And I'm having to do this one the weekend before it's due out.
sentences.zh: 我不得不在这期节目发布前的周末来录制这一期。

sentences.en: So, you know, this is, you know, just pulling out the bag, real world style.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这就叫临阵磨枪，现实风格。

sentences.en: But I really, you know, I thought I could give it, could give it a miss for one week.
sentences.zh: 但是真的，你知道的，我本以为我可以偷懒停播一周。

sentences.en: And I thought I don't want to.
sentences.zh: 但我转念一想，我不想这么做。

sentences.en: I want the consistency of showing up for you week in, week out, because I know that many of you,
sentences.zh: 我希望每周都能雷打不动地为你们呈现内容，因为我知道你们很多人，

sentences.en: because you've told me, you lovely people, are really enjoying having this podcast as part of your weekly routine.
sentences.zh: 因为你们亲口告诉我，亲爱的听众们，你们真的很享受把这个播客作为你们每周日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: So many of you are listening to it on your commute as you go to work, perhaps on a Monday.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人在通勤上班的路上听它，或许是在周一。

sentences.en: Some of you are running to the sound of my voice.
sentences.zh: 还有些人伴着我的声音跑步。

sentences.en: I don't know what your tempo is like, because I've also been told I'm quite relaxing to listen to.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们的跑步节奏是怎样的，因为我也听人说过，听我的声音感觉挺放松的。

sentences.en: Maybe you're all about the jingles.
sentences.zh: 也许你们更喜欢听片头音乐。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you know, I've become the fabric, not the fabric.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，你知道的，我已经成为了你们日常生活的织物，不对，不是织物。

sentences.en: That sounds really big headed.
sentences.zh: 听起来太自大了吧。

sentences.en: I've become some of the fabric of your day to day lives, which is a real honour, you know, a real privilege.
sentences.zh: 我已经融入了你们日常生活的点点滴滴，这真是一种莫大的荣幸，你知道的，一种巨大的特权。

sentences.en: And as I record this right now, we are at about 5,700 downloads.
sentences.zh: 就在我录制这段音的时候，我们的下载量大约达到了5,700次。

sentences.en: And so this is, you know, this is really exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这真的很令人兴奋。

sentences.en: I'm really honoured that so many of you are really valuing and enjoying the content.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸有这么多的人真正看重并喜欢这些内容。

sentences.en: And it means a great deal to me that you listen to it, that you like it, and that you tell me that you like it as well.
sentences.zh: 你们收听它、喜欢它，还告诉我你们喜欢它，这对我有极大的意义。

sentences.en: So thank you from the bottom of my heart.
sentences.zh: 为此我发自内心地感谢你们。

sentences.en: But, yeah, so thinking about how we deal with this stuff, you know.
sentences.zh: 不过，是的，回过头来想想我们是如何处理这些事情的，你知道的。

sentences.en: So sometimes it can be really interesting and useful, in fact, to have conversations about this sort of stuff in supervision with your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 有时候，在督导中与你的督导员就这类事情进行对话，其实可以非常有趣且有用。

sentences.en: Thinking about, you know, whether this shows up more for some clients than others.
sentences.zh: 思考一下，你知道的，这种情绪是不是在某些客户身上比在其他人身上表现得更明显。

sentences.en: So this is where the practice of, you know, perhaps having a reflective journal can be useful as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，写反思日记这种做法，你知道的，也许在此时也能派上用场。

sentences.en: So you cannot be making notes about clients so that they are identifiable.
sentences.zh: 所以你不能记录关于客户的可识别信息。

sentences.en: But, you know, one way of doing that is if you tended to see the same client, you know, every Tuesday morning at 9.15, then you could write, you know.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，其中一个方法是，如果你倾向于每周二早上9点15分见到同一个客户，那么你就可以写下来。

sentences.en: So I notice that, you know, my, you know, 12.30 on a Friday client or whatever, I often feel like I, you know, I can't be bothered.
sentences.zh: 所以我注意到，你知道的，我的，你知道的，周五12点半的客户或者其他什么人，我经常觉得我，你知道的，我提不起劲。

sentences.en: And maybe, you know, maybe that's about the time.
sentences.zh: 也许，你知道的，也许这跟时间有关。

sentences.en: So maybe you're hungry, you know, or maybe it's post-lunch slump.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你饿了，你知道的，或者也许是午后精力不济的时候。

sentences.en: And you're just like having a really kind of slumpy, you know, maybe you're just digesting your food.
sentences.zh: 而你只是觉得整个人状态很差，你知道的，也许你只是在消化食物。

sentences.en: And so all of the brain power you'd usually have has disappeared to your stomach.
sentences.zh: 因此你通常拥有的所有脑力都跑到你的胃里去了。

sentences.en: And so you might just find that you're feeling a bit sluggish.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会发现自己感觉有点迟钝。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's not always necessarily about the client.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这并不一定总是和客户有关。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's about the time of day.
sentences.zh: 有时是和一天中的时间有关。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's about the emotional node of everything else on your caseload as well.
sentences.zh: 有时也和你的 caseload（个案量）中其他事情的情绪节点有关。

sentences.en: So maybe you're really enjoying, you know, the therapy work that you're doing.
sentences.zh: 所以也许你真的很享受，你知道的，你正在做的治疗工作。

sentences.en: But maybe you're finding the team harder work or you are finding it difficult with your supervisor or you're feeling generally a bit pressured or unsupported.
sentences.zh: 但也许你觉得团队工作更难应付，或者你觉得督导很难相处，或者你普遍感到有点压力或缺乏支持。

sentences.en: So it's not always about the clients.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不总是和客户有关。

sentences.en: But if it is, you know, you notice in your reflective journals or your reflective practice,
sentences.zh: 但如果确实有关，你知道的，你在反思日记或反思实践中注意到这一点，

sentences.en: if you notice that it seems to be the same client that you are finding it hard to feel energised by, then it's definitely worth discussing that in supervision.
sentences.zh: 如果你发现某个客户似乎让你很难对他们产生热情，那么这绝对值得在督导中讨论。

sentences.en: And it might also be worth thinking about what that client brings to the room as well.
sentences.zh: 而且思考一下这位客户给咨询室带来了什么，可能也很有价值。

sentences.en: And a virtual room counts as a room as well.
sentences.zh: 虚拟咨询室也算是一个咨询室。

sentences.en: You know, are they low energy?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们是低能量状态吗？

sentences.en: Are they needing more from you?
sentences.zh: 他们需要你付出更多吗？

sentences.en: Are they leaving you feeling drained?
sentences.zh: 他们离开时让你感到精疲力竭吗？

sentences.en: Are you finding that you're having to stifle yawns as you're together?
sentences.zh: 你发现你们在一起时自己不得不强忍哈欠吗？

sentences.en: And if that's happening, it can often be worth thinking about whether there is a role for you.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况正在发生，通常值得思考一下这其中是不是有你的角色。

sentences.en: So I'm not saying there isn't a role, but whether a role is being left open for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不是说没有你的角色，而是说是否有一个角色正留给你去扮演。

sentences.en: Because if you're feeling redundant, you know, you're making you feel like you want to yawn,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你感到无所事事，你知道的，让你觉得想打哈欠，

sentences.en: then it might be that you're being talked at and any kind of opportunity that you have to try and open up a conversation
sentences.zh: 那么可能是你在被动听对方说话，而任何试图开启对话、

sentences.en: or have a more functional, helpful session is being shut down or can't be responded.
sentences.zh: 或者进行更具功能性且有帮助的会谈的机会都被堵死了，或者无法得到回应。

sentences.en: And it's perhaps feeling a bit more one-sided.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能会让人觉得有点单向。

sentences.en: And so that can feel a little bit less than exciting.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会让人觉得没那么令人兴奋。

sentences.en: You know, if you find yourself clock-watching, then that is not good use of your time.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果你发现自己在看表计时，那说明你的时间没有得到充分利用。

sentences.en: And it's not great use of the client's time as well, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，这对客户时间的利用也不是很好。

sentences.en: So people often will start therapy with me and they're like, oh, I know this is going to get worse before it gets better.
sentences.zh: 所以人们开始找我做心理治疗时经常会说，哦，我知道这在变好之前会先变得更糟。

sentences.en: But my take on that is that with appropriate warming up to each other and absolutely with the appropriate stabilisation, there might well be some tricky realisations along the way.
sentences.zh: 但我对此的看法是，通过彼此适当的预热，并且绝对要做好适当的情绪稳定工作，在这个过程中很可能会出现一些棘手的领悟。

sentences.en: But I would really hope, certainly now that I've been qualified for 11 years almost,
sentences.zh: 但我真的希望，当然现在我获得资质已经快11年了，

sentences.en: I would really hope that my clients are now comfortably staying within their window of tolerance by the time we get to anything tricky.
sentences.zh: 我真的希望我的客户在我们探讨任何棘手问题时，已经能够舒适地保持在他们的耐受窗口之内了。

sentences.en: And sometimes I find that I'm having to undo or redo stuff that's been done not quite so skilfully in the past
sentences.zh: 有时我发现我不得不去撤销或重做过去那些做得不太熟练的事情，

sentences.en: that has left clients feeling vulnerable, scared, you know, out of control.
sentences.zh: 那些事情曾让客户感到脆弱、害怕，你知道的，失控。

sentences.en: And as a result, a bit terrified, actually.
sentences.zh: 结果，实际上还有点恐惧。

sentences.en: So, yeah, when clients are coming to you, you know, almost ready to be hurt, I think that that's our need to do stabilisation work
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当客户来到你面前时，你知道的，几乎做好了受伤的准备，我认为这就需要我们去做稳定工作，

sentences.en: and to really make sure that the client can handle thinking about these difficult things by the time you actually get round to them.
sentences.zh: 并且真正确保客户在你们真正开始探讨这些困难事情的时候，能够应对这些思考。

sentences.en: One of my top tips for just making sure that you are managing things OK is if it's in keeping with your requirements at your individual work,
sentences.zh: 确保你把事情处理好的顶级小贴士之一，就是如果它符合你个人工作场所的要求，

sentences.en: if I am taking annual leave, then I will usually try to leave the first day of annual leave clear in my diary
sentences.zh: 如果我要休年假，我通常会尝试在日程表上把年假的第一天留空，

sentences.en: so that I can battle through the email backlog so that I can fight any fires that might have, you know,
sentences.zh: 这样我就可以集中精力处理积压的电子邮件，这样我就可以扑灭那些可能，你知道的，

sentences.en: broken out in my absence and so that I can probably finish reports that I need to do
sentences.zh: 在我不在的时候爆发的火灾，这样我就可以把需要写的报告写完，

sentences.en: and paperwork like that, like paperwork and bits and so that I can finish any paperwork and bits and pieces
sentences.zh: 还有诸如此类的文书工作，比如文书工作之类的事情，以便我能完成任何文书工作和零碎事务，

sentences.en: and just make sure that I am as available as possible to clients rather than fretting about what might be at the bottom of my inbox.
sentences.zh: 并确保我对客户尽可能保持可及性，而不是去烦恼收件箱底部可能有什么。

sentences.en: Because when I've worked in mental health services, you know, you go off for a week and you hope everything will be OK,
sentences.zh: 因为当我在心理健康服务机构工作时，你知道的，你休假一周，你希望一切都会好，

sentences.en: but, you know, you don't know what emails you might have had.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，你不知道你可能会收到什么电子邮件。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, my little kindness to myself has been to plan that time in.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我对自己的小小的善意就是把这段时间规划好。

sentences.en: And similarly, on occasions where I have left jobs and where I have left clinical placements on training,
sentences.zh: 同样，在我离职以及在培训期间离开临床实习的场合，

sentences.en: I have tried to give myself two solid weeks of non-client contact at the end of any contract.
sentences.zh: 我一直在尝试在任何合同结束时给自己留出整整两周的非客户接触时间。

sentences.en: Because these reports do take time, you know, sorting through all the stuff to shut down your role
sentences.zh: 因为这些报告确实需要时间，你知道的，要整理好所有事情以结束你的角色，

sentences.en: and to leave things safe and write care plans and discharge letters and, you know, have goodbye lunches with your team and things like that.
sentences.zh: 并确保事情安全、编写护理计划和出院信，你知道的，和你的团队吃告别午餐等等。

sentences.en: That takes time.
sentences.zh: 这需要时间。

sentences.en: And so, yes, you know, that is potentially two more weeks worth of where you could be seeing clients.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你知道的，这可能相当于两周你可以用来见客户的时间。

sentences.en: But this stuff matters.
sentences.zh: 但这些事情很重要。

sentences.en: You do need to have all the stuff I just mentioned in place, you know.
sentences.zh: 你确实需要把刚才我提到的所有事情都落实到位，你知道的。

sentences.en: You don't want to be writing that from home, you know, when you're not being paid to do it.
sentences.zh: 你可不想在家写这些，你知道的，在没有报酬的时候。

sentences.en: You want to be able to use your, you know, your compassionate, well-rested self in that important communication with your clients.
sentences.zh: 你希望能够在与客户的重要沟通中，展现出你那富有同情心、休息充分的自我。

sentences.en: I love writing therapeutic letters.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢写治疗信。

sentences.en: I really, you know, I really enjoy that.
sentences.zh: 我真的，你知道的，我真的很喜欢那样做。

sentences.en: And I often do that with a client as well in one of our final sessions.
sentences.zh: 我经常在最后几次会话中与客户一起这样做。

sentences.en: But if I haven't done that or if I need to have a more formal closing report, then that needs to be written.
sentences.zh: 但如果我还没这样做，或者如果我需要写一份更正式的结案报告，那么这就需要写下来。

sentences.en: And that does take time.
sentences.zh: 这确实需要时间。

sentences.en: So please do give yourself time as you wind down from holidays and as you wind down from work roles altogether.
sentences.zh: 所以在你从假期中放松下来以及完全结束工作角色时，请务必给自己留出时间。

sentences.en: Yeah,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: before you move on to a new and exciting work role, it can be tricky to stay, you know, with your head in the game when you've got your sights set on a new or different role.
sentences.zh: 在你转入一个新的、令人兴奋的工作角色之前，当你把目光投向一个新角色或不同角色时，要想保持专注可能会有点棘手。

sentences.en: But, yeah, whatever's going on for you right now, you know, sending you my good wishes and my compassionate vibes as ever.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，无论你现在正经历什么，你知道的，一如既往地向你发送我的美好祝愿和富有同情心的能量。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你收听今天的节目。

sentences.en: I have no idea how long this episode is currently.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道这一集目前有多长。

sentences.en: And I know I started off talking about something at the beginning and I said, like, oh, that's kind of not related.
sentences.zh: 我知道我一开始在开头讲了某个事情，然后我说，哦，那个有点不相关。

sentences.en: I maybe come back to it, but it might be that I need to I didn't write it down.
sentences.zh: 我可能会回头再说它，但也可能需要我——我没把它写下来。

sentences.en: It might be that I need to do a new podcast episode on that.
sentences.zh: 我可能需要为此做一个新的播客节目。

sentences.en: Um, so I hope you find this helpful.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我希望你觉得这有帮助。

sentences.en: If you've got any feedback for me, please, please do let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果你对我有任何反馈，请务必让我知道。

sentences.en: Um, all reviews and testimonials are so gratefully received.
sentences.zh: 嗯，收到所有的评价和推荐我真的非常感激。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: And if you are on my LinkedIn, um, Dr. Marianne Trent LinkedIn, um, you can actually write me a testimonial on there as well.
sentences.zh: 如果你在我的领英上，嗯，Dr. Marianne Trent领英，嗯，你其实也可以在上面给我写推荐。

sentences.en: And the way that you do that is you go to my profile page and then you scroll down, down, down, down, down, past the skills.
sentences.zh: 你这样做的方法是去我的个人主页，然后一直往下滚动，往下，往下，往下，往下，滑过技能。

sentences.en: Um, and then you will see where some other people have written recommendations and you just create your own.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后你会看到其他人写推荐的地方，然后你就可以创建你自己的了。

sentences.en: Um, and then I'll be able to approve that and we'll add that to my profile and everybody will have a great day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，然后我就能批准它，我们会把它添加到我的个人资料中，每个人都会度过美好的一天。

sentences.en: That's what I'm saying.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想说的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for being part of my world.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你成为我世界的一部分。

sentences.en: If you are listening at any point other than the 9th of May, then you should be able to watch all of the compassionate Q and A's on replay by going, um, to the playlist, um,
sentences.zh: 如果你在5月9日以外的任何时间收听，那么你应该能够通过前往，嗯，播放列表，嗯，

sentences.en: on my YouTube, which is Good Thinking Psychological Services.
sentences.zh: 在我的YouTube上，也就是 Good Thinking Psychological Services，观看所有富有同情心的问答的回放。

sentences.en: But yeah, whatever your feelings, stay kind to yourself and know that you're only having these thoughts because you're human.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，无论你有什么感受，对你自己好一点，并且要知道你产生这些想法只是因为你是人类。

sentences.en: And so if some days you can't really be bothered, um, you know, that is just because the way that our brains are put together.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有些日子你真的提不起劲，嗯，你知道的，那只是因为我们大脑的结构方式。

sentences.en: But if you find that those days are becoming more and more common, then it's a good idea to chat that through.
sentences.zh: 但如果你发现这样的日子越来越多，那么最好把这件事拿出来聊聊。

sentences.en: But with your supervisor, it might even be useful to get some therapy yourself.
sentences.zh: 但要和你的督导一起，甚至自己去做点心理治疗也可能会很有用。

sentences.en: Just think about what that might be about, because we want you to not to burn out in this career.
sentences.zh: 只要想想要是那样会是怎样，因为我们希望你在这个职业生涯中不要精疲力竭。

sentences.en: We want you to feel like generally speaking, it's really something that you are impassioned about.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你觉得总的来说，这真的是一件让你充满热情的事情。

sentences.en: Um, and honestly, that is the way I feel about most of my days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，老实说，我对我的大部分日子都是这种感觉。

sentences.en: Um, so yeah, I want you to want you to feel the same.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以，是的，我希望你也觉得是这样。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, thank you so much, um, for listening and I will look forward to, um, speaking to you again soon.
sentences.zh: 嗯，但是，是的，非常感谢，嗯，你的收听，我期待着，嗯，不久后再次与你交谈。

sentences.en: Don't forget that new episodes drop 6am every Monday UK time.
sentences.zh: 别忘了新节目在英国时间每周一早上6点发布。

sentences.en: Um, and if you subscribe, it will come straight to you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你订阅了，它就会直接发送给你。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Have a good day.
sentences.zh: 祝你有美好的一天。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Psychologists.
sentences.zh: 心理学家们。

sentences.en: What if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 如果你能通过出卖时间赚钱之外还能赚到钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是 Dr. Marianne Trent，临床心理学家，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将你的专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022, and I've since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后我也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses, plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我自己的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团（masterminds）、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的犒赏，以及限时一对一教练指导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday, the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
